name: identitystore
description: The Identity Store service used by IAM Identity Center provides a single place to retrieve all of your identities (users and groups).

subcommands.name: create-group
subcommands.description: Creates a group within the specified identity store.

subcommands.name: create-group-membership
subcommands.description: Creates a relationship between a member and a group.

subcommands.name: create-user
subcommands.description: Creates a user within the specified identity store.

subcommands.name: delete-group
subcommands.description: Delete a group within an identity store given GroupId.

subcommands.name: delete-group-membership
subcommands.description: Delete a membership within a group given MembershipId.

subcommands.name: delete-user
subcommands.description: Deletes a user within an identity store given UserId.

subcommands.name: describe-group
subcommands.description: Retrieves the group metadata and attributes from GroupId in an identity store.

subcommands.name: describe-group-membership
subcommands.description: Retrieves membership metadata and attributes from MembershipId in an identity store.

subcommands.name: describe-user
subcommands.description: Retrieves the user metadata and attributes from the UserId in an identity store.

subcommands.name: get-group-id
subcommands.description: Retrieves GroupId in an identity store.

subcommands.name: get-group-membership-id
subcommands.description: Retrieves the MembershipId in an identity store.

subcommands.name: get-user-id
subcommands.description: Retrieves the UserId in an identity store.

subcommands.name: is-member-in-groups
subcommands.description: Checks the user's membership in all requested groups and returns if the member exists in all queried groups.

subcommands.name: list-group-memberships
subcommands.description: For the specified group in the specified identity store, returns the list of all GroupMembership objects and returns results in paginated form.

subcommands.name: list-group-memberships-for-member
subcommands.description: For the specified member in the specified identity store, returns the list of all GroupMembership objects and returns results in paginated form.

subcommands.name: list-groups
subcommands.description: Lists all groups in the identity store.

subcommands.name: list-users
subcommands.description: Lists all users in the identity store.

subcommands.name: update-group
subcommands.description: Updates the specified group metadata and attributes in the specified identity store.

subcommands.name: update-user
subcommands.description: Updates the specified user metadata and attributes in the specified identity store.
